_comment: Single source of route/component/contract metadata for the visual-regression issue-agent handoff. Consumed by BOTH the Python package (scripts/visual_triage/context.py reads `routes` + `route_keywords`) and the workflow cjs (.github/scripts/visual-regression-failure-issue.cjs reads `suites` + `generic_suggested_files`). Keep this file in the sparse-checkout list of visual-regression-failure-issue.yml.

/.purpose: Main landing dashboard summarizing cluster, policy, workload, and operational cards.

/clusters.purpose: Cluster management view showing registered clusters, status, and navigation context.

/settings.purpose: Configuration surface for user, integration, and console settings.

/ci-cd.purpose: Pipeline and deployment status dashboard for CI/CD workflows.

/cluster-admin.purpose: Administrative cluster operations and management controls.

/workloads.purpose: Workload inventory and health overview across clusters/namespaces.

/quantum.purpose: Quantum demo UI with circuit, histogram, qubit grid, and control cards.

/compliance.purpose: Compliance, policy, and posture overview for the environment.

suites.name: Core app visual regression
suites.contract: Core dashboard, clusters, and settings layouts must stay stable against committed baselines.

suites.name: Dashboard routes visual regression
suites.contract: Dashboard route layouts must remain visually stable across key product routes.

suites.name: Dashboard filter panel layout
suites.contract: The global filter panel must open without shifting dashboard stats or layout.

suites.name: Compliance filter panel visual regression
suites.contract: The global filter panel must overlay the compliance page without layout shift.

suites.name: Cluster admin visual regression
suites.contract: Cluster admin page layouts must remain visually stable across desktop and tablet viewports.

suites.name: CI/CD visual regression
suites.contract: CI/CD dashboard screenshots must stay stable across initial, populated, full-page, and tablet views.

suites.name: Workloads visual regression
suites.contract: Workloads page layouts and grouped sections must stay visually stable.

suites.name: Quantum visual regression
suites.contract: Quantum cards, control panel, and circuit viewer visuals must remain stable.
